name: Andron Gant
summary: Andron Gant is a reclusive, frequently intoxicated Forsaken residing in the murky depths of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. He handles occasional research commissions for local mages.

sections.title: A Slurring Informant
sections.body: Lounging amidst the noxious fumes of the Apothecarium, Andron Gant rarely ventures beyond the safety of the Undercity's stone walls. To the casual observer, he appears to be little more than a drunken scholar, occasionally hiring adventurous couriers to retrieve obscure relics like the Tablet of Markri from distant shores on behalf of local mages.

sections.title: Unmasked by the Deathstalkers
sections.body: Gant's treacherous dealings did not escape the notice of Undercity's intelligence network. When the Syndicate dispatched a courier named Astor Hadren to collect a ledger of compromised data, aspiring operatives within the Deathstalkers intercepted the runner. Disguised as Hadren, an agent was able to trick the drunken Gant into parting with his incriminating ledger without raising an eyebrow, handing Lord Varimathras definitive proof of Gant's treason against the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where can I find Andron Gant?
faq.answer: Andron Gant is located inside the Undercity, lingering in the lower levels of the Apothecarium district.

faq.q: Why is Andron Gant interested in Azshara tablets?
faq.answer: Gant acts as an intermediary for certain Undercity mages, arranging payments to scavengers and contacts like Jediga to recover ancient relics from the ruins of Azshara.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers investigate Andron Gant?
aliases: who does andron gant work for
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers investigate his dealings with outside contacts and seek intelligence about his research commissions.

faq.q: Who directs the investigation into Andron Gant?
faq.answer: The Deathstalkers investigate Gant on behalf of Lord Varimathras, seeking intelligence about his contacts and research.

angles.text: Forsaken rogues climbing the ranks of the Deathstalkers learn firsthand through Gant how drunkenness and complacency can unravel even the tightest espionage operations.
Gant serves as a stark reminder that loyalty among the Forsaken is never guaranteed, and human criminal factions like the Syndicate have eyes even within Lordaeron's catacombs.
